definitions.explanation: Exactly twelve o'clock in the middle of the day.

examples.japanese: {正午|しょうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正午|しょうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{正午|しょうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Once it passes noon, it becomes afternoon.

examples.japanese: {正午|しょうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦お{昼|ひる}ごはん→昼ごはん：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べよう→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Let's eat lunch when it's noon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正午|しょうご}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}する→出発する：01832_shuppatsusuru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: The plane was scheduled to depart at exactly noon, but it was delayed due to bad weather.

notes:
{正午|しょうご} means exactly 12:00 PM (noon). More precise and formal than ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧, which loosely refers to midday or daytime.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正午|しょうご}: exactly 12:00 PM (precise, formal)
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧: noon/daytime/midday (casual, approximate)
- ⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧: polite form; often means "lunch" or "lunchtime"
- ⟦{真|ま}{昼|ひる}→真昼：18020_mahiru⟧: broad daylight, the middle of the day

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {正午|しょうご}⟦ちょうど→ちょうど：02916_choudo⟧: exactly at noon
- {正午|しょうご}⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎ：09885_sugi⟧: past noon, shortly after 12:00
- {正午|しょうご}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: before noon
- {正午|しょうご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧: the noon news

USAGE:
Used in schedules, announcements, and news. In everyday conversation, ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ or ⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧ is more natural: ⟦お{昼|ひる}→お昼：02532_ohiru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}おう→会う：00482_au⟧ (let's meet at noon) rather than {正午|しょうご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}おう→会う：00482_au⟧.
